tag: 包裝供應商評選比較對話

level.why: 對話含讓步、條件與關係子句，需整合兩家供應商的品質、交貨紀錄、價格與推薦資料；字彙偏抽象（habitual、invaluable），干擾項取自文中相近的比較資訊。

passage:
Dana: Thanks for joining me, Marcus. We have narrowed the packaging supplier choice to Delta Pack and Norwood Containers, and according to the quality report, Delta's defect rate was below one percent last year.
Marcus: True, but I am concerned about their delivery record. Several clients mention habitual delays, and if those problems recur during our peak season, our production line could stop.
Dana: Fair point. Norwood is more reliable, and it ships internationally, which would help with our new European plant. They also sent a reference letter from an executive at a major beverage company, and their team has practical experience with products like ours.
Marcus: That is invaluable. Still, their prices are about eight percent higher than Delta's. With constant pressure to control costs, can we justify that?
Dana: Let us ask Norwood for a revised quote and make the final decision on Friday.
zh:
黛娜：謝謝你來，馬庫斯。我們已經把包裝供應商的選擇縮小到德爾塔包裝與諾伍德容器兩家，而根據品質報告，德爾塔去年的瑕疵率低於百分之一。
馬庫斯：沒錯，但我擔心他們的交貨紀錄。好幾位客戶都提到他們經常延遲，如果這些問題在我們的旺季再次發生，生產線可能會停擺。
黛娜：有道理。諾伍德比較可靠，而且可以出口到全球各地，這對我們新的歐洲廠有幫助。他們也寄來一封由某大型飲料公司主管出具的推薦信，而且他們的團隊對類似我們的產品具有實務經驗。
馬庫斯：這非常有價值。不過，他們的價格比德爾塔高出約百分之八。在持續要控制成本的壓力下，我們有辦法說得過去嗎？
黛娜：我們請諾伍德重新報價，然後在週五做出最後決定吧。

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
opts: How to reduce defects on the production line
Whether to open a new European plant
Which packaging supplier the company should choose
How to negotiate a lower price with Delta Pack
why: 錯誤：瑕疵率只是比較供應商的一項資料。
錯誤：歐洲廠是提到供應商出貨能力時的背景。
正解：兩人在比較兩家包裝供應商，決定要選哪一家。
錯誤：兩人是在考慮 Norwood 的價格，並非與 Delta 議價。

questions.q: What is Marcus's concern about Delta Pack?
opts: It has a record of late deliveries that could stop production
Its defect rate is higher than last year
It does not ship to other countries
Its prices are eight percent higher
why: 正解：他擔心 Delta 經常延遲交貨，可能使生產線停擺。
錯誤：Delta 的瑕疵率低於百分之一。
錯誤：能否國際出貨是 Norwood 的優點，不是 Delta 的疑慮。
錯誤：價格高出百分之八的是 Norwood。

questions.q: What do the speakers decide to do?
opts: Ask Norwood for another reference letter
Ask Norwood for a revised quote and decide on Friday
why: 錯誤：兩人並未立即選定 Delta。
錯誤：對 Norwood 的價格仍有疑慮，沒有決定接受。
錯誤：推薦信已經收到，沒有再要求。
正解：她提議請 Norwood 重新報價，並在週五做最後決定。

questions.q: The supplier agreed to ______ the order within two weeks of receiving payment.
why: 錯誤：agreed to 後接動詞原形，不接 -ing。
正解：to 後接動詞原形 fulfill。
錯誤：過去式不能接在 to 之後。
錯誤：名詞不能在此作動詞。

questions.q: The final decision depends ______ the results of the factory inspection.
why: 錯誤：depends of 不是正確搭配。
錯誤：depends to 不是正確搭配。
正解：depend on 為固定搭配，表示「取決於」。
錯誤：depends at 不是正確搭配。

questions.q: Inventory levels must be monitored ______ to prevent shortages during peak season.
why: 正解：副詞 regularly 修飾被動動詞 monitored。
錯誤：regular 為形容詞，不能修飾動詞。
錯誤：regularity 為名詞，詞性不符。
錯誤：regulate 為動詞，語意與詞性不符。
